- For migraines, the best treatments include over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen or ibuprofen, as well as prescription medications like triptans or ergots. Lifestyle changes like stress reduction, adequate sleep, and avoiding triggers may also help.
- For tension headaches, the best treatments include relaxation techniques like deep breathing or meditation, over-the-counter pain relievers, and physical therapy or chiropractic care to relieve muscle tension.
